question: Where did Milton spend his time of isolation?
solution:
The correct answer is "**London**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **last **paragraph of the passage, it is mentioned that **he was home in London when he wrote Elegia Prima.**
 
• **Hence, we can say that Milton spend his time of isolation "In London"**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
